prompt:
小红书社媒卡。排版：无独立标题，根据主题创作。上下带框两宫格，每一格都是上面一行字，下面配图，图文无明显分界，纯色背景，较多留白空间，角色高度概括，构图简单。

本次输入：【填写画幅、标题、主视觉、各区短文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
Xiaohongshu social-media card. Layout: no separate headline; create from the theme. Two framed panels stacked vertically; each panel has one line of text above an illustration, with no hard text-image division. Solid-color background, generous negative space, highly simplified characters, and a simple composition.

Inputs: [Provide aspect ratio, headline, main visual, and short copy for each section].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
